'''The Godsheart''' was a [[Pulsar/Legends|pulsar]],<ref name="LoNH" /> a rapidly rotating [[Neutron star/Legends|neutron star]],<ref name="GG8">''[[Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts]]''</ref> that was located within the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Star/Legends|star]] lay off [[The Dead Road]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].<ref name="LoNH" />

The pulsar was considered sacred by members of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]], with some of them believing the star was connected to their species' destiny. For [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] in their ancient history, they made divinations that were based on the Godsheart's changing flashes. The Hutts also believed that the pulsar led them from their destroyed [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Varl/Legends|Varl]] to their new home [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. [[Scientist/Legends|Scientists]] and [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] of the [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] species used a [[Unidentified Sakiyan facility|facility]] near the Godsheart to enrich the element [[graxitium]].<ref name="LoNH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Godsheart was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the star in grid square T-11.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
